        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n  const verifiedWorkEmail = user?.verified_work_email as string | undefined;\n  const isApproved = user?.is_approved as boolean | undefined;\n\n  // Check if user is authenticated\n  if (\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/login\") &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\")\n  ) {\n    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has verified work email (for protected routes)\n  if (\n    user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\") &amp;&amp;\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !verifiedWorkEmail\n  ) {\n    // User is logged in but hasn't verified work email\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user is approved (for protected routes)\n}",

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]",

        "contents": "3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Database constraint ensures only valid domains in approved_emails\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify and link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Link the email identity to current Google user\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n  provider: 'email'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nCheck JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |\n\n| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |\n\n| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security\n5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\"https://127.0.0.1:3000\"]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL. If not set, defaults to the local API URL (http://127.0.0.1:&lt;port&gt;/auth/v1).\n# jwt_issuer = \"\"\n# Path to JWT signing key. DO NOT commit your signing keys file to git.\n# signing_keys_path = \"./signing_keys.json\"\n# If disabled, the refresh token will never expire.\nenable_refresh_token_rotation = true\n# Allows refresh tokens to be reused after expiry, up to the specified interval in seconds.\n# Requires enable_refresh_token_rotation = true.\nrefresh_token_reuse_interval = 10\n# Allow/disallow new user signups to your project.\nenable_signup = true\n# Allow/disallow anonymous sign-ins to your project.\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false\n# Allow/disallow testing manual linking of accounts",

        "contents": "# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nauth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"\n\n# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n[auth.mfa]\n# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.\nmax_enrolled_factors = 10\n\n# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)\n[auth.mfa.totp]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\n\n# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging\n[auth.mfa.phone]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\notp_length = 6\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Configure MFA via WebAuthn\n# [auth.mfa.web_authn]\n# enroll_enabled = true\n# verify_enabled = true\n\n# Use an external OAuth provider. The full list of providers are: &#96;apple&#96;, &#96;azure&#96;, &#96;bitbucket&#96;,\n# &#96;discord&#96;, &#96;facebook&#96;, &#96;github&#96;, &#96;gitlab&#96;, &#96;google&#96;, &#96;keycloak&#96;, &#96;linkedin_oidc&#96;, &#96;notion&#96;, &#96;twitch&#96;,\n# &#96;twitter&#96;, &#96;x&#96;, &#96;slack&#96;, &#96;spotify&#96;, &#96;workos&#96;, &#96;zoom&#96;.\n[auth.external.apple]\nenabled = false\nclient_id = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nsecret = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET)\"\n# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.\nredirect_uri = \"\"\n# Overrides the default auth provider URL. Used to support self-hosted gitlab, single-tenant Azure,\n# or any other third-party OIDC providers.\nurl = \"\"\n# If enabled, the nonce check will be skipped.       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "create table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Database constraint ensures only valid domains in approved_emails\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify and link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Link the email identity to current Google user\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n  provider: 'email'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nCheck JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |\n\n| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |\n\n| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security\n5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Work email linked?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]\n        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}\n        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]\n        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table\n\n   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)\n2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Key tables structure\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 165
          }
        },
        "contents": "create table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "create table public.user_profiles (",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),",

          },
          {
            "text": "  verified_work_email text unique,",

          },
          {
            "text": "  google_email text,",

          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now(),",

          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "// lib/constants/auth.ts",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "export const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "  'studenti.czu.cz',",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "  'pef.czu.cz',",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "] as const;",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "export const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "};",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "## Supabase Configuration Changes",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "Update [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth]",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.email]",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.external.google]",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "client_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "secret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "### Blocked Scenarios",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",
            "lineNumber": 165
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.35464099049568176
    },

| Replace with Google login button only |\n\n| &#96;app/auth/confirm/route.ts&#96; | Keep - used for OTP verification |\n\n| &#96;app/auth/error/page.tsx&#96; | Keep - error handling |\n\n| &#96;components/auth-button.tsx&#96; - Rewrite with Google button only\n- &#96;app/auth/verify-work-email/page.tsx&#96; - Work email + OTP form\n- &#96;app/auth/pending-approval/page.tsx&#96; - Simple \"pending\" message\n- &#96;app/admin/users/page.tsx&#96; - Approved emails table (admin only)\n\n### Components (2 files)\n\n- &#96;components/google-login-button.tsx&#96; - Single OAuth button\n- &#96;components/work-email-form.tsx&#96; - Email input + OTP verification\n\n## Key Security Features (Handled by Supabase)\n\n1. **RLS Policies**:\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile\n   - Only admins can manage approved emails\n   - Approved emails table viewable only by admins\n\n2. **Custom JWT Claims Hook**:\n\n   - Runs on every token refresh\n   - Embeds role, verified_work_email, and is_approved directly in JWT\n   - No additional DB queries needed for authorization checks\n\n3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)",

          {
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;supabase/migrations/001_auth_tables.sql&#96; - Tables + RLS",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;supabase/migrations/002_custom_claims_hook.sql&#96; - JWT claims function",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "### Frontend (3 pages)",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app/auth/login/page.tsx&#96; - Rewrite with Google button only",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app/auth/verify-work-email/page.tsx&#96; - Work email + OTP form",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app/auth/pending-approval/page.tsx&#96; - Simple \"pending\" message",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app/admin/users/page.tsx&#96; - Approved emails table (admin only)",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "### Components (2 files)",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;components/google-login-button.tsx&#96; - Single OAuth button",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;components/work-email-form.tsx&#96; - Email input + OTP verification",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "## Key Security Features (Handled by Supabase)",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **RLS Policies**:",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Users can only read/update their own profile",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Only admins can manage approved emails",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Approved emails table viewable only by admins",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Custom JWT Claims Hook**:",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Runs on every token refresh",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Embeds role, verified_work_email, and is_approved directly in JWT",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No additional DB queries needed for authorization checks",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Domain Validation**:",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)",
            "lineNumber": 344
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Testing custom claims hook**: Execute and iterate on the Postgres function directly\n2. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n3. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n4. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and JWT claims\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Run SQL queries to test the custom_access_token hook function\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into approved_emails table\n- Inspect auth.users and user_profiles tables\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96;         "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without approval                     | Middleware checks &#96;is_approved&#96; JWT claim           |\n\n### Optional: &#96;before_user_created&#96; Hook (Extra Layer)\n\nPostgres hook to reject any user not created via Google:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\nbegin\n  -- Only allow users created via Google OAuth\n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata'-&gt;&gt;'provider' != 'google' then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'decision', 'reject',\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\n    );\n  end if;\n  return event;\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/reject_non_google_signup\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Access Token Hook\n\nPostgres function to embed claims in JWT:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\ndeclare\n  claims jsonb;\n  user_role text;\n  work_email text;\n  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./lib/supabase/proxy.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 51
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 105,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims().         "contents": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches:\n      - preview\n      - production\n    paths:\n      - 'supabase/**'\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      environment:\n        description: 'Environment to deploy to'\n        required: true\n        type: choice\n        options:\n          - preview\n          - production\n\njobs:\n  deploy_staging:\n    environment: preview\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/preview' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp;         "contents": "import Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Button } from \"./ui/button\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"./logout-button\";\n\nexport async function AuthButton() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // You can also use getUser() which will be slower.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const verifiedWorkEmail = user?.verified_work_email as string | undefined;\n\n  return user ? (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"&gt;\n      {verifiedWorkEmail ? (\n        &lt;span className=\"text-sm\"&gt;{verifiedWorkEmail}&lt;/span&gt;\n      ) : (\n        &lt;span className=\"text-sm\"&gt;{user.email}&lt;/span&gt;\n      )}\n      &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  ) : (\n    &lt;Button asChild size=\"sm\" variant={\"outline\"}&gt;\n      &lt;Link href=\"/auth/login\"&gt;Sign in&lt;/Link&gt;\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",
        "signatures": {},

          {
            "text": "import { LogoutButton } from \"./logout-button\";",

          },
          {
            "text": "export async function AuthButton() {",

          {
            "text": "  const supabase = await createClient();",

          },

            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  // You can also use getUser() which will be slower.",
            "lineNumber": 9

          {
            "text": "  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  const user = data?.claims;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },

            "text": "  const verifiedWorkEmail = user?.verified_work_email as string | undefined;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  return user ? (",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"&gt;",

          },
          {
            "text": "      {verifiedWorkEmail ? (",

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "      ) : (",

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "      )}",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    &lt;/div&gt;",

          },

            "text": "  ) : (",

        "contents": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n# PRD — [Product Name] MVP\n\n## 1. Overview\n[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]\n\n---\n\n## 2. System Goals\n- [Goal 1: core outcome]\n- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]\n- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]\n\n---\n\n## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas\n\n### Example: &#96;users&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  phone text unique,\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table subscriptions (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  user_id uuid references users(id),\n  stripe_customer_id text,\n  stripe_subscription_id text,\n  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]\n\n---\n\n## 4. Features\n\n### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment\n\n* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]\n* **Phone Verification:**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;\n  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;\n* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync\n\n### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces\n\n#### Web Chat\n\n* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;\n* Flow:\n\n  1. Store in DB\n  2. Call LLM agent with context\n  3. Save + return assistant reply\n\n#### SMS (Twilio example)\n\n* Input:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"From\": \"+12025550123\", \"To\": \"+12025550999\", \"Body\": \"Remind me tomorrow at 9am\" }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n* Output:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"status\": \"stored\", \"thread_id\": \"thread_123\", \"task_created\": true }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Email\n\n* Inbound: \\[Webhook flow]\n* Outbound: \\[Gmail API, SMTP, etc.]\n* Input: &#96;{ from, to, subject, body }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"sent\", message_id }&#96;\n\n### 4.3 Assistant Capabilities\n\n* **Calendar**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ action, title, time, attendees }&#96;",

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\"https://127.0.0.1:3000\"]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Testing custom claims hook**: Execute and iterate on the Postgres function directly\n2. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n3. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n4. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and JWT claims\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Run SQL queries to test the custom_access_token hook function\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into approved_emails table\n- Inspect auth.users and user_profiles tables\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; {\n    try {\n      const result = await performFeatureAction({\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\n        ...input\n      });\n      \n      return { success: true, data: result };\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      throw new CustomError(\"INTERNAL_ERROR\", \"An unexpected error occurred\");\n    }\n  });\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### tRPC Router Template\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/server/api/routers/[feature].ts\nimport { createTRPCRouter } from \"../trpc\";\nimport { actionProcedure } from \"../procedures/[feature]\";\n\nexport const featureRouter = createTRPCRouter({\n  action: actionProcedure,\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Error Template\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/lib/errors.ts\nexport class CustomError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    public code: string,\n    message: string,\n    public statusCode: number = 500\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = \"CustomError\";\n  }\n}\n\nexport const createCustomError = (code: string, message: string, statusCode?: number) =&gt;         "contents": "└─ e2e/                       # End-to-end tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Directory Conventions\n\n- Use **kebab-case** for folders and files\n- Co-locate tests next to source: &#96;*.test.ts(x)&#96;\n- Export from &#96;index.ts&#96; barrels only when it helps DX without circular deps\n\n## Next.js App Router Rules\n\n### Server vs Client Components\n\n- **Default to RSC** (no \"use client\"). Use client components only for:\n  - Interactivity (event handlers)\n  - Browser APIs (localStorage, window, etc.)\n  - Third-party libraries requiring client-side initialization\n\n### Server Boundaries\n\n- Keep data access in server context (RSC, server actions, API routes)\n- API routes in &#96;app/api&#96; are for external webhooks only\n- Use internal APIs (tRPC, server actions) for app-to-app communication\n\n### Performance &amp; UX\n\n- Use &#96;&lt;Suspense&gt;&#96; for async UI; provide skeletons\n- Implement proper loading and error boundaries\n- Use Next.js caching (&#96;revalidateTag&#96;, &#96;revalidatePath&#96;) appropriately\n- Prefer Edge runtime for simple operations, Node for complex ones\n\n### Accessibility\n\n- All interactive elements must have proper roles and labels\n- Ensure keyboard navigation support\n- Provide ARIA attributes where needed\n- Test with screen readers\n\n## API Architecture\n\n### Internal APIs (tRPC Recommended)\n\n- Organize by feature domains\n- Use Zod for input validation\n- Implement proper error handling with custom error classes\n- Keep business logic server-side (no JSX in API layer)\n- Write integration tests with mocked external services\n- **Router logic should be application code only** - delegate to business logic services\n- **Use only protected procedures** for all endpoints\n- **Split procedures and routers** into separate files for better organization\n\n### Application Logic vs Business Logic\n\n**Application Logic** (in tRPC procedures):\n- Input validation and sanitization\n- Authentication and authorization checks\n- Request/response formatting\n- Error handling and mapping\n- Delegation to business logic services\n- Logging and observability",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "└─ e2e/                       # End-to-end tests",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "### Directory Conventions",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use **kebab-case** for folders and files",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- Co-locate tests next to source: &#96;*.test.ts(x)&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "- Export from &#96;index.ts&#96; barrels only when it helps DX without circular deps",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "## Next.js App Router Rules",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "### Server vs Client Components",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Default to RSC** (no \"use client\"). Use client components only for:",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Interactivity (event handlers)",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Browser APIs (localStorage, window, etc.)",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Third-party libraries requiring client-side initialization",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### Server Boundaries",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keep data access in server context (RSC, server actions, API routes)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "- API routes in &#96;app/api&#96; are for external webhooks only",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use internal APIs (tRPC, server actions) for app-to-app communication",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "### Performance &amp; UX",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use &#96;&lt;Suspense&gt;&#96; for async UI; provide skeletons",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- Implement proper loading and error boundaries",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use Next.js caching (&#96;revalidateTag&#96;, &#96;revalidatePath&#96;) appropriately",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prefer Edge runtime for simple operations, Node for complex ones",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "### Accessibility",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "- All interactive elements must have proper roles and labels",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "- Ensure keyboard navigation support",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- Provide ARIA attributes where needed",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- Test with screen readers",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## API Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "### Internal APIs (tRPC Recommended)",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "- Organize by feature domains",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use Zod for input validation",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "- Implement proper error handling with custom error classes",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keep business logic server-side (no JSX in API layer)",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- Write integration tests with mocked external services",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Router logic should be application code only** - delegate to business logic services",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Use only protected procedures** for all endpoints",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Split procedures and routers** into separate files for better organization",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "### Application Logic vs Business Logic",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "**Application Logic** (in tRPC procedures):",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- Input validation and sanitization",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- Authentication and authorization checks",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- Request/response formatting",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- Error handling and mapping",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "- Delegation to business logic services",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- Logging and observability",
            "lineNumber": 108
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2302244007587433

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function SignUpForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [repeatPassword, setRepeatPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleSignUp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    if (password !== repeatPassword) {\n      setError(\"Passwords do not match\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n        email,\n        password,\n        options: {\n          emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/protected&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      router.push(\"/auth/sign-up-success\");\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",
